posts.title: Large Angle Period of the Pendulum
posts.description: Introductory physics texts often derive the approximate formula \(T = 2 \pi \sqrt{\frac{L}{g}}\) for the period of a pendulum. This approximation is accurate for small amplitudes, but at larger amplitudes the period grows. posts.title: The Illusory Dunning-Kruger Effect and Reciprocal Fits
posts.description: The Dunning–Kruger (DK) effect states that people with low skill tend to overestimate their ability, while those with high skill tend to underestimate theirs. Though intuitive, the central evidence in the original DK paper [1] was famously invalid — its analysis produces the same pattern even when participant predictions are completely unbiased.
